verdict.rationale: Deel's first-party docs describe webhooks that deliver real-time notifications for key platform events as an alternative to polling, and say deliveries are secured with HMAC-SHA256 signatures. That covers the core of subscribing to events via webhooks. missing for 10: an event catalog or list of subscribable event types, documentation of how subscriptions are created or managed (API or UI), retry and delivery-guarantee details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
